idea.hook: I used to think investing was for high earners
idea.why: Opening with a misconception the audience likely holds and then correcting it creates an immediate sense of value and earns saves.
idea.adapt: Start a carousel with 'I used to think [common money myth]' and walk through the mindset shift using a simple local example such as CPF OA interest versus leaving cash idle.

idea.hook: A sentimental moment that reminded me why I joined this business
idea.why: A personal, honest reflection with a memorable line (be a person first) builds trust and feels unlike typical sales content.
idea.adapt: Share one real client moment that reminded you why you became an advisor, and end with a single principle you hold yourself to.

idea.hook: I could tell you I know investing. Or show you.
idea.why: It challenges the usual focus on platforms and points to the advisor's expertise as the thing worth checking, then proves it with a real portfolio.
idea.adapt: Show an anonymised portfolio or plan review that explains your reasoning, so prospects can judge your thinking rather than take your word for it.
